name: Feudal 'De Jure' Laws
description: These are the laws that organize the feudal society of our country.

name: Levy Law
description: Our army is made up mainly of levies that are recruited from certain [estates|e] of our country, who will fight for us until we disband them.

name: Royal Court Customs
description: The traditions and the culture of the court play a significant role in the stability of the [ShowGovernmentTypeName('monarchy')]. These customs will ensure the safe transition of power from ruler to heir, and limit the court intrigues significantly.

name: Legitimization of Power
description: A monarchy can only survive as long as its subjects believe in the legitimacy of their ruler. There are many ways in which rulers justify their power. As time goes on, new political philosophies will arise which explain the need for a strong government in their own ways.

name: Harem Laws
description: The harem is a significant institution within the royal household, and secures the production of heirs for the succession.

name: Iqṭā'
description: #italic $iqta_law$#! is the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] practice of 'tax farming': collecting land revenues from the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] as part of #italic Zakāh#!, the giving of alms, which [ShowReligionGroupAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('muslim')] states generally collect to form their base income.

name: Inquisition Law
description: Originally established to combat the heresy of [ShowReligionName('catharism')], the Inquisition has become the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] Church's primary tool for investigating and prosecuting heresy. Via specialized ecclesiastical courts, trained inquisitors investigate potential heretics, extract confessions of religious or moral transgression, and impose punishments ranging from penance to execution, for violating Catholic mores.

name: Society of Jesus
description: The Society of Jesus, commonly known as the Jesuits, is a religious order founded by Ignatius of Loyola as part of the Counter-Reformation. Jesuits are distinguished from other Catholic orders by their emphasis on education, scholarship, and performing missionary work.

name: Role of the Patriarchate
description: The Patriarchate is a major pillar of our faith, and an institution with considerable influence over the state.

name: Censorship
description: The ability to control which literary works can be distributed, and whether opinions counter to established dogma are allowed, is essential to religious cohesion and generally favored by the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')]. However, these restrictions are frowned upon by free thinkers and creative professionals, and can have profound consequences for the availability of [artists|e] and for any [work_of_art|e] deemed heretical.

name: Slave Conversion
description: Our slaves come from many different lands, and thus bring with them diverse beliefs. We may need to regulate those closely, lest we risk corrupting our own populace by permitting their exposure to deviant practices and rituals.

name: Foundation of Republic
description: Our Republic is founded on the principle that power should be in the hands of the people, not a single absolutist ruler. Yet as with any government, its laws and decisions must be respected and obeyed to maintain order, necessitating the creation of complex administrations in order to govern.

name: Election
description: Elections are the cornerstone of our republic, ensuring that there are reasonable limits on those in power while giving the people the ability to select rulers that best serve their interests.

name: Republican Power
description: As any government, the Republic must not only make decisions, but also act upon them. To do so, it needs a way of exercising its executive capabilities so that they reach even the furthest areas of the country.

name: Administrative Principles
description: If we wish to be an example for all our citizens, the Republic must uphold principles which dictate the course of action we take with our policies.

name: Republican Electorate Law
description: Elections are the foundational concept of our republic, and as such, the most important factor in determining the course of the Republic is deciding who is eligible vote in those elections.

name: Theocratic Leadership
description: A Theocratic Leadership governs this country, where religious authorities hold political power and religious law often supersedes secular law.

name: Holy Mission
description: The guideline for our every action is the Holy Mission we have been granted from our divine ruler. The vision the higher power has foreseen for us shall come to fruition!

name: Nature of our Faith
description: Religion is the pillar of our entire society, and as such, the nature of our faith plays a role in all facets of our culture. No major decisions can be made without carefully considering the religious perspective of taking these actions.

name: Divine Cause
description: While monarchies and republics may be content to simply exist in the world, a Holy State requires a deeper, more spiritual calling. This Divine Cause shall guide our hand towards a glorious destiny.

name: Legal Basis
description: This legal foundation will serve as the basis for the state's first formal code of law. Its goal is simple, yet noble: to secure a just society where all may live in peace and prosperity.

name: Tribal Organization
description: Any group of people requires some form of organization in order to survive and thrive. Tribal organization emphasizes collective identity and customary law, and can be small- or large-scale.

name: Tribal Religious Values
description: The religious values of our tribe dictate not only how we live, but how we treat those who do not share our beliefs and traditions, both within and outside of our territory.

name: Tribal Migration
description: Our people do not permanently occupy out lands. Instead, we travel freely, as fate and our people's needs dictate.

name: Tribal Cultural Identity
description: As time progresses, so does our understanding of our culture and identity. We no longer have to fear neighboring tribes; we have tamed the wilderness and have become its master. Now it is time to embrace who we are as a people.

name: Tribal Modernization
description: The time has come to discard our old ways and embrace a position in the larger world. No longer seen as a mere tribe, we shall officially become a country, one that represents and defends our people and the way we live.

name: Education of the Elites
description: The education of our elites is of vital importance. By providing our upper-class citizens with ample access to appropriate works of art, we will further our cultural goals, both at home and abroad, through the creation of legendary works and the amplification of our splendor!

name: Education of the Masses
description: The education of our population is of vital importance. By providing our people with ample access to the appropriate materials, regardless of their place in the social hierarchy, we will create a more educated and artistically fluent population, and further our governmental goals both at home and abroad.

name: Slavery Laws
description: The influx of workers and cheap labor from external sources has long been a cornerstone of our economy, both at home and abroad. The matter of embracing or banning is a clear reflection of what place the lower strata, and slaves in particular, occupy in our society.

name: Colonial Policy
description: This establishes the policy that our country will follow for colonial affairs.

name: Native Policy
description: This establishes the policy that our country will follow regarding the native people inhabiting our colonies.

name: Administrative System
description: Any kind of state requires a system to administrate and organize its territory. By selecting an appropriate structure, we can ensure that our authority is enforced in even the most remote parts of our state.

name: Intelligence Agency
description: The intelligence agency is an organization within the state which conducts spycraft activities such as espionage, cryptography, and providing security from internal threats.

name: Bureaucratic Offices
description: $modern_bureaucracy_desc$

name: Cabinet Laws
description: The cabinet is the highest office in the government and our ruler's personal advisors. Cabinet ministers and secretaries enjoy special privileges and rights.

name: Economic Policy
description: A nation's economic policy sets out specific economic objectives and means to achieve them, and makes decisions and creates regulations for taxation, spending, currency, trade, and more.

name: Cultural Traditions
description: Ancient tradition is the foundation of many cultures and civilizations. While progress is what will drive us to greatness, our traditions will always serve us as the reminder of our origins, and as a source for the strength and unity of our people.

name: Foreign Cultural Law
description: As our state grows in size, so does the complexity of our social structures. Cultural unity within our state is no longer a given, and we now require policies to establish and maintain internal peace.

name: Marriage Law
description: Marriage law refers to the legal framework that governs the institution of marriage within a particular jurisdiction.

name: Heir Religion
description: The ability to decide the religion of the [heir|e] holds significant importance in matters of succession and governance. It allows rulers and governments to maintain religious stability, ensuring that the beliefs and practices of the ruler align with those of the majority of their subjects. Ultimately, the power to determine the religion of the heir represents an important element in the fine balance of religious freedom, governance, and societal harmony.

name: Coinage Law
description: This law determines the resources our country will use to mint its currency. The most common coins are made of gold, silver, and copper, with different mixtures of each material and also different monetary values. However, other exchange systems exist throughout the world that do not depend on this type of currency, but rather on other materials, such as livestock, cloth, shells, cacao, etc.

add.desc: we always want this because it's better

name: Precious Metal Distribution
description: [ShowGoodsName('goods_gold')|U] and [ShowGoodsName('silver')] are the materials necessary for the minting of coins. As our state is in the highly enviable position to gather these precious metals ourselves, it is our right to decide who gains access to these resources.

name: Press Laws
description: This determines how print media outlets in a country are run and regulated.

name: Mining Law
description: This law determines who owns the mining operations in our country.

name: Amazigh Familial Connections
description: The many tribes across our land hold certain authority over local affairs. Our stance towards them may define the course of our history.

name: Border Controls
description: This Law determines if [migration|e] is allowed in or out of the country.

name: Legal Code
description: For as long as people have gathered together in societies, they have created laws to govern their actions and interactions. Legal codes are a reflection of the values and beliefs of a society, shaping everything from how people conduct business to how they treat each other. They are the very fabric that holds a society together, providing a framework for order and justice. Despite their differences, people tend to share a common goal: to create a just and fair society where everyone can live in peace and prosperity.

name: Language of Pleading
description: The customs of our social hierarchy and legal proceedings must be concisely and uniformly written down in the language we find most appropriate.

name: $sharia$ Jurisprudence
description: $sharia_law_policy_desc$

name: Recruitment Law
description: Battles cannot be won with no soldiers on the field! Recruiting fighters is an absolute necessity. As time goes on, how we recruit soldiers may change, and our forces will adapt to it as needed.

name: Battle Leadership Law
description: An army is only as good as its leadership. An incompetent general can be the bane of their nation, while a military leader of great prowess will be known and feared on every battlefield.

name: Army Doctrine
description: Army doctrines represent skillsets in which our [army|e] can specialize. The longer we work under these doctrines, the more entrenched they become in our military culture, and the more skilled we become at them. Over time, this can lead to powerful benefits for our glorious forces.

name: $mamluk$ Rank System
description: The hierarchy within our military is the framework that makes up the most important institution of our land.

name: $mamluk$ Army Law
description: The heart of our stratocratic administration is none other than the army. By drafting laws and stipulations to carefully form it, we will defend our people efficiently against outside threats.

name: $mamluk$ Promotion Law
description: The legalities that premiate promotion within our military ranks are an important cornerstone of our country.

name: Maritime Law
description: Maritime laws, also known as admiralty laws or marine laws, are a specialized set of legal principles and regulations that govern various aspects of maritime activities and commerce. These laws encompass a broad range of matters related to navigation, shipping, trade, and maritime activities taking place on oceans, seas, and other navigable waterways. They cover areas such as maritime contracts, vessel ownership and registration, marine insurance, salvage and wrecks, liability and compensation for maritime accidents, crew rights and responsibilities, and many other aspects that pertain to maritime affairs. Maritime laws are designed to ensure safe, orderly, and fair practices in the maritime industry and resolve disputes that may arise in the context of maritime activities.

name: Piracy Law
description: Piracy laws define the official position our nation adopts when addressing the challenges posed by piracy. These laws encompass statutes, regulations, and legal doctrines aimed at combating or managing piracy effectively. They embody the collective strategy and measures our nation implements to uphold maritime security and protect our waters from piracy threats. Or perhaps they are just the rules we stick to when committing acts of piracy...

name: Naval Doctrine
description: Naval Doctrines represent skillsets in which our [navy|e] can specialize. The longer we work at doctrines, the more entrenched they become in our navies and the better we get at them. Over time this can lead to powerful bonuses for our glorious fleets.

name: Sumptuary Law
description:
Clothing in [ShowReligionAdjective('nahuatl')] society reflects our social hierarchy and marks important life events such as marriage, birth, and death. The [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] typically wear simple cotton garments, while high-ranking elites dress in far more elaborate attire decorated with brilliant colors and priceless feathers. Warriors, by contrast, are permitted to wear only plain mantles.

The Cihuacóatl is now establishing Sumptuary Laws that will regulate how subjects dress, what they may purchase in markets, and which ornaments they may wear, all based on their rank.

name: Order of the Garter
description:
The Order of the Garter is a prestigious symbol of our realm's highest ideals, transcending time and uniting worthy people of diverse backgrounds and talents.

Whether composed of the monarch's favorites, esteemed foreign dignitaries, devout members of the clergy, gifted artisans, or valiant warriors, this venerable order is the pinnacle of nobility and virtue.

name: Fouage Tax Levy
description: A large Hearth Tax levied against the peasantry in order to assist in covering the growing expenses of the treasury.

name: Taille
description: The #italic taille#! is a tax imposed on each household based on the amount of land it occupies. The [GetEstateName('clergy_estate')] and [GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] are exempt.

name: Machault's Five Percent Tax
description: A new tax proposed by the Minister of Finance, accounting for one-twentieth of the annual income.

name: Reformation Edicts
description: The Reformation is sweeping across [ShowContinentNameWithNoTooltip('europe')], and [GetCountry('FRA').GetName] is on the front lines of its outbreak. State policy towards these emerging zealots will be critical in making them our friends — or foes.

name: Colonial Aspirations
description: Having overcome decades of turmoil, [GetCountry('FRA').GetName] has reached a point where it can finance overseas exploration. New policies will enable the court to pursue colonial ambitions with greater efficiency

name: Status of Jansenism
description: A doctrine following the teachings of Saint Augustine, #italic Jansenism#! emphasizes predestination, the profound and lasting effects of original sin, and rigorous morality. It has increasingly come under threat with the rise of Absolutism in [GetCountry('FRA').GetName], as well as having been officially condemned by the [GetCountry('PAP').GetAdjective] Bull #italic Unigenitus#!.

name: Primacy of Florentine Guilds
description: The powerful mercantile institutes that make up our social fabric, the merchant guilds are an important proponent of our continued prosperity and affluence. Though all of them are important, it is undeniable that some are better at obtaining power and influence than others.

name: Estudo Geral
description: The [ShowModifier('por_estudo_geral')] is a national [ShowBuildingTypeName('university')] that aims to educate the citizens of our humble state. Its location and proximity to the capital is a crucial matter to us.

name: [ShowGoodsNameWithNoTooltip('amber')] Monopoly
description: [ShowGoodsName('amber')] is amongst the most prized resources within our state. Its trade is of ample importance and must be regulated carefully.

name: Navarrese Adaptability
description: Being positioned between two larger nations has forced our nation to adapt or die. With a mixture of intelligent alliances and swift military actions, our realm has managed to survive despite its smaller size. This ability to quickly adjust our actions to suit our specific needs is an edge that we should never lose.

name: Six Ministries Supervision
description: The work of the [ShowLawName('six_ministries')] must be supervised by another agency, or perhaps even the monarch.

name: Ashta Pradhan Council
description: $mhr_ashta_pradhan_desc$

name: Dominant Currency
description: A focus on different types of currencies is bound to shape our country in many diverse ways, not just economically, but socially as well.

name: Mesta Council
description: The Mesta Association together with its council protects the rights and interests of the livestock owners in our country.

name: Examination System
description: Those wishing to enter the civil service and advance as government officials must take a series of examinations testing their knowledge of Confucian literature and statecraft.

name: Status of the Han
description: Our dynasty originates from outside the core territory of the [GetInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName], making us outsiders to the Han [ShowCultureGroupName('chinese_group')] majority.

name: Distribution of [GetCountry('SCO').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Clan Holdings
description: The inheritance of [GetCountry('SCO').GetAdjective] holdings is divided proportional to clan influence, with larger clans recieving more holdings. Clan holdings are passed directly to the heir, unless a title is revoked or goes extinct.

name: Authority over the Clergy
description: [GetCountry('SCO').GetAdjective] contribution to the [ShowSpecialStatusNameWithNoTooltip('curia')] have become a burden on the state's finances. Seeking to curtail [ShowSpecialStatusNameWithNoTooltip('curia')] contributions, the state has taken direct jurisdiction over the clergymen.

name: [GetCountry('SCO').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Colonial Affairs
description: With tales of riches from the new world, [GetCountry('SCO').GetName] stands to reap the benefits should it establish a sizable colonial basis. Although an overambition may prove catastrophic for the state's economic stability.

name: [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('orthodox')] Status within the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip]
description: In order to garner support for restoring the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName], a compromise was reached with the [GetCountry('PAP').GetLongName] regarding strengthening [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] supremacy over the local [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] branch.

name: Distribution of Power
description: Distribution of Power determines how authority is divided among the ruler, administrative bodies, and estates. The state is a complex and fragile entity — a well-balanced power distribution ensures stability, while giving any single institution too much power risks breeding tyranny or administrative paralysis.

name: Rights of the $nobles_estate$
description: The position of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.

name: Rights of the $burghers_estate$
description: The position of the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.

name: Rights of the $clergy_estate$
description: The position of the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.

name: Rights of the $crown_estate$
description: The position of the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.

name: Rights of the $peasants_estate$
description: The position of the [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.

name: Administration of Italian Lands
description: Defines how the crown governs its Italian territories in the wake of the Italian Wars.

name: The Witchcraft Act
description: If we are to live a life of piety and root out the corruption and evil among us, we must address the growing concerns of many around the existence of witches and the practice of the occult.

name: The Holy Office
description: The Holy Office has been requesting greater jurisdiction over religious life in the Most Serene Republic. We must now choose whether to comply with this request, or to defend the religious freedom of our subjects.

name: The Frontier Fortresses
description: Our domain is surrounded by many aggressive neighbors. To protect our people, we must invest in fortifications on our frontiers, enduring they are adequately funded and supplied.

name: Enclosure Movement
description: The Enclosure Movement is the process by which formerly communal land is surrounded by walls or fences, and thus transformed into private property.

name: Taxation
description: Stable revenue is key for a functioning government. By implementing a legal taxation framework, we can regulate tax collection from individuals and entities.

name: Factory Working Conditions
description: The expansion of our manufacturing industry is accelerating industrialization and boosting production capacity. As factory workers become increasingly central to the economy, regulating their rights in order to prevent exploitation becomes vital.

name: Trade Unions
description: During the early onset of industrialization, trade unions play a crucial role in shaping labor rights and working conditions. These unions negotiate with employers in order to secure better wages, shorter working hours, and safer conditions for their members through collective bargaining.

name: Vestiarium
description: Establishing and upholding legal regulations for managing state assets is important for efficient resource allocation and controlled spending. It is necessary for administration and helps the ruling authorities make decisions related to a variety of priorities.

name: Tìfāyìfú
description: $mch_queue_hair$ shall be regarded as our cultural policy towards the [ShowCultureGroupName('chinese_group')]. Amongst the chief requirements shall be for the Hàn to organize their hair in the Biànzi style.

name: Monastic Reformation Movement
description: The Possessors and Non-Possessors have different views on the role of wealth within the Church and its impact on the spiritual life of clergy and followers.

name: Intellectual Movements
description: The ideological perspectives of the nineteenth century divides man to such extent that entire movements emerge, each stemming from the apparent discord among different philosophical, political, and cultural viewpoints.

name: Dahsala Taxation
description: Instead of allowing local taxation laws to develop for the common people within $india$, organizing them all within the $dahsala_system$ will allow us to properly tax them.

name: Military Frontier
description: We have established a military frontier to protect the nation from heathen hordes that are encroaching upon our borders.

name: Alcohol Restrictions
description: In order to balance out the religious duties of the servants of our faith, and the desires of our people, we must decide if the consumption alcohol is allowed or not.

name: Golden Bull
description: The $golden_bull$ is the decree of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] which defines and creates the constitutional structure of the Empire, especially the Electoral College. Other laws and Imperial Reforms all build on the $golden_bull$.

name: Imperial Tax Law
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] requires gold to function like any other political entity. A series of tax laws can be applied to siphon gold from the members to ensure financial stability of the Empire.

name: Imperial Register
description: The $military_contribution$ is a list that specifies the exact number of troops each estate must supply to the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Imperial Religion
description: The very foundations of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] are built on religious beliefs.

name: Electorate Religious Law
description: Religion is a major pillar of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] for Emperors and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')] alike.

name: Imperial Succession
description: The succession of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] is a delicate matter. The right of succession to the Imperial Throne is prescribed in the Imperial Laws.

name: Imperial Voting
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] is built upon the principle of Imperial election. The nature of that election defines the balance of power in the Empire.

name: Electorate Organization
description: The [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')] are a group of powerful [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] who have the privilege to vote for their next [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Secularization of the Electorate
description: Traditionally the Electorate is split between the [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')] and the [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')]. In case political dynamics threaten the lands of the [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')], the empire might consider a full secularization of their positions.

name: Free Cities
description: The Free Cities of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] are self-ruling cities with autonomy. They are usually where Imperial Diet meetings are held.

name: Free City Rights
description: Obtaining the status of a [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] is not easy. This exclusive title must be conferred by the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Landfriede
description: The #italic Landfriede#!, or 'land peace,' is a decree which dictates that disputes between members of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] must be settled in the Imperial Court rather than on the battlefield. This mandate helps us stay cohesive as an empire, rather than becoming weak through petty in-fighting.

name: Imperial Diet
description: The [ShowParliamentTypeName('hre_court_assembly')] is an ancient system, and therefore many of its stipulations and procedures are very outdated. It is time to rework it and establish a proper [ShowLawNameWithNoTooltip('imperial_diet_law')] that better protects the diverse interests of all members of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('hre').GetName].

name: Perpetual Diet
description: Previously, Imperial Diets convened irregularly in various cities across the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('hre').GetName], requiring the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] and other representatives to travel each time. By establishing a permanent, continuously-sitting Diet, we shall create a standing assembly that operates on a system of constant deliberation, rather than sporadic meetings.

name: Power of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle]
description: The Power of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] is a complicated topic. Members of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('hre').GetName] and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')] alike have conflicting interests with those of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle], yet they recognize that a powerless  [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] is in no position to protect the Empire.

name: Imperial Circles
description: The $imperial_circles_law$ divides the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] into geographic administrative regions, each led by a designated [circle_leader|e].

name: Civil Registration
description: A system aimed at keeping track of all our subjects within our realm as a step towards improving the quality of life for all under our banner.

name: Tax Base System
description: Taxation is the basis of any country's economy. By establishing a proper taxation system throughout the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName], we can more effectively reap the wealth of our territories.

name: Provincial Governorship
description: The vastness of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] is unparalleled. In order to effectively rule our massive holdings, we shall establish a system of provincial administrators.

name: Cèfēng Tǐzhì
description: The tributary system has been present in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] since its inception, as all nations around it dutifully recognize the authority of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Kējǔ Examination
description: The Imperial Examination system aims to identify the best and most educated candidates to serve in our bureaucracy. This will ensure that only the brightest minds in our nation are the ones turning the wheels of the administration, and thus that they turn smoothly.

name: Outwards View
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] has been expanding its power outwards since its inception, but external threats mean we require a certain degree of caution about who is able to enter its borders.

name: Tiānxià
description: The concepts of our territorial influence and expansion are guaranteed by our right to rule, which is granted by Heaven itself.

name: Jakūn Gūsa
description: Serving mainly as our military, the Eight Banners system also function as the basis of the organization of society in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName]. Their role should be clearly defined, so that they do not lose their focus.

name: Six Ministries
description: The $six_ministries$ are the distinct administrative divisions of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName], each one with its own tasks and duties.

name: $middle_kingdom$
description: Imperial decrees are the key to the well functioning of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName], ensuring that the authority of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetLeaderTitle] gets enforced throughout.

name: Clan Residence
description: There should be clear laws defining where the leaders of the different clans must reside, to properly keep the balance of power.

name: Overseas Interaction
description: $japan_region$ has always had the luxury of being separated from other countries by the sea. This distance makes closing our borders to the outside world very easy.

name: Buke Shohatto
description: A series of edicts defining the proper behavior of the samurai. They are designed to inspire the samurai to improve themselves.

name: Administration Law
description: This law defines the way our people will be administered.

name: Clan Taxation Law
description: This law defines the level of Taxation that will be applied to our people.

name: Court Etiquette Law
description: This law establishes which court etiquette rules will be applied.

name: Formal Script Law
description: This law declares which script or writing system must be used to write official documentation.

name: Bureaucratic Law
description: This law lays out the legal framework employed by our bureaucracy.

name: Economic Law
description: This law defines the distribution of all crops grown in our settlements.

name: Trade Relations Law
description: This law sets out constraints for trade partnerships.

name: Clan Diplomacy Law
description: This law describes how diplomacy will be handled by our people.

name: Unification Law
description: States whether the tribes of the Confederation can either act independently, or be forced to submit to a central authority.

name: Policy Proposal Frequency
description: A law regulating the administration of law proposals within the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName].

name: [ShowCultureGroupNameWithNoTooltip('swiss_group')] Representative
description: Every kind of organization will require a spokesman - a representative - who shall be the face to the political entities inside and outside of the organization. The [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] might pose an exception to this rule though...

name: [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle] Power
description: The representative of the Confederation could request for more power and influence within the union in order to strengthen their position on the public stage.

name: Election Method
description: The process of electing the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle] of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] is a delicate matter which requires an exact legislature to be handled properly.

name: Ruling Period
description: The Confederation might have a [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle] representing it. Yet, it must be determined if said [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle] shall serve the union lifelong or until a certain time has passed.

name: Election Frequency
description: As the matters of the [ShowLawName('sc_ruling_period')] are cleared, a new topic arises which handles the frequency of the elections of a new [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('swiss_confederation').GetLeaderTitle].

name: Internal Politics
description: While the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] is first and foremost a union for defensive purposes, it is clear that the internal affairs of the Confederation must be handled too.

name: Membership Regulation
description: The [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] is an organization originally made by the [ShowCultureGroupName('swiss_group')] people to defend themselves against the growing influence of the [GetDynasty('habsburg_dynasty').GetName] in the local region. However, the rules who can join are never set in stone...

name: War Politics
description: The external threats of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] are many. Unified terms of how the [ShowCultureGroupName('swiss_group')] defend each other are needed if the Confederation is to survive the political anarchy around it.

name: Religious Affairs
description: With the breakout of the [ShowSituationName('reformation')], the religious unity of the Confederation is a precarious situation. A solution must be found or else the conflict of faith threatens to tear the union apart.

name: Imperial Relations
description: The [GetInternationalOrganizationType('swiss_confederation').GetName] has been part of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] since its inception. However, the [ShowSituationName('reformation')] left a bitter taste for many members of the Confederation...

name: $SWI_ADJ$ Unification
description: The [ShowCultureGroupName('swiss_group')] lands have been splintered for far too long. If the people of the Alps wish to see prosperity and security, they have to unite under a single banner.

name: Rule of Ireland
description: The shape of rule in Ireland can be as wild as the great Atlantic crashing against the craggy cliffs, or as steadfast as the bogs.

name: Unification of the $colonial_federation$
description: With bonds forged in the fires of our struggle for independence, it is time to consider the unification of the loosly bound lands of our members.

name: Tradition
description: The specific traditions and beliefs followed by this [hindu_branch|e].

name: The Purchase of Indulgence
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] on the matter of Indulgences.

name: Papal Authority
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] on the matter of papal authority.

name: Veneration of Saints and Reliquaries
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] on the matter of veneration of saints and reliquaries.

name: Simony
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] on the matter of simony.

name: Society of Jesus
description: The official relations of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] towards the Order of the Jesuits.

name: Persecution of Witchcraft
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] on the existance of Witchcraft and other occult practices.

name: The Marriage of Priests
description: The official stance of the [GetInternationalOrganization('catholic_church').GetName] towards the ability of its priests to marry.

name: Union Foundation
description: The law of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] which determines its very nature and if it should follow a centralized or federal future - if it can stand the test of time.

name: Codified Inheritance
description: In order to secure the stability of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName], the inheritance laws of each member must be codified so that each state has the same line of succession.

name: Economy of the Union
description: One monarch might rule over multiple thrones, yet the members of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] are very separated in their economy. This law shall bring all of them closer to each other.

name: Diplomatic Liberties
description:
As the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] is led from a single throne, so comes the question of how the diplomacy of the $union$ shall be handled.

#Y The matters of warfare, though, are nonetheless in the hands of the Estates of our union partners.#!

name: Legislature of the Union
description: The adminstration of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] requires a cohesive design. An approved, unitary system of a legislature is imperative to ensure the stability of the $union$.

name: Question of Unification
description: The [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] is in its most variations nothing but a loose confederation of different states ruled from the same throne. However, the possibility of a unification under the banner of the [ShowSpecialStatusName('senior_partner')] is not out of question...

name: Mutual Offense
description: Although first and foremost defensive in its nature, the military might of a [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] can be called to support each other in military campaigns - if the state members agree to such obligation.

name: Nature
description: Known also as physis (#italic φύσις#!), this tenet rests at the core of our beliefs. It stands for the undisputed fact that Jesus Christ is of a dual and harmonious nature. The coexistence of humanity and divinity is the basis of coexistence that we shall strive to live by.

name: Christology
description: The thelogical study around the nature of Christ, His identity and the union of his various natures is a delicate art. Many scholars classify Christ as fully divine, thus they subscribe to $high_christology$, while other adhere to the disciplines of $low_christology$.

name: Liturgical Practices
description: Various worship practices centered around hymns, readings and rites.

name: Essence
description: Known also as ousia (#italic ουσία#!), this tenet represents the interpretation of the Divinity of God as being the same as the Divinity of Christ.

name: Hypostasis
description: Deriving from the core concept of concrete reality (#italic υπόστασις#!), this tenet delves into the essence and nature of Christ and God, and their divine essences taking a single or multiple manifestations.

name: Prosopon
description: Originally meaning Mask (#italic πρόσωπον#!), this tenet centers on the Person of Christ, and whether He is a single individual or includes two different divine and human individuals.

name: Christological Debates
description: Debates on the aspect of Christ, our stance towards our brethren sects and our position on the nature of worship are the lifeblood of keeping our belief alive and vibrant!

name: Double Sabbath
description: The Sabbath has been the holy day reserved to God since the times of Moses. It may still be preserved as a day of rest, or it could be considered to be superseded by the Lord's Day on Sunday.

name: Interpatriarchal Relations
description: Despite the different Patriarchs being autonomous in their decisions and not reporting to any higher authority, they are still part of the same faith. It is thus inevitable and even necessary to have some interaction and common discussions.

name: Ruler and Patriarch Relations
description: The Patriarch works for the souls of the people and that sometimes puts him in interaction with the earthly authority. What role should the countries rulers take when interacting with the Patriarch is also a matter of the faith.

name: Colonial Representation
description: Our own influence on the land we govern is detetmined by the whims of our overlord.

name: Mutual Defense
description: The policy outlining how members will defend each other in the event of war being declared.

name: Mutual Offense
description: The policy outlining how members will support each other in the event of them declaring war against another country.

name: Main Philosophy
description: The main current of philosophy and teachings that form the core beliefs of a sect.

name: Tantric Practices
description: Vajrayāna, also called Tantric $buddhist$ or Esoteric $buddhist$, is a form of $buddhist$ that incorporates many tantric, esoteric, and ritualistic practices. Its development has been strongly influenced by other religions, especially $hindu$.

name: Sect School
description: The particular school of this sect, which may have some differences from mainstream of teachings.

name: Khalsa
description: A warrior community tasked with the defense of [ShowReligionName('sikhism')] and its followers, its rules of conduct and initiation will set a standard for all the faithful.
